top_signals.title: China shuts hundreds of banks as Beijing moves to shore up its financial system
top_signals.summary: Beijing shuttered 670 mainly rural banks last year in a bid to create fewer, larger and better-capitalized lenders.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: CFTC Proposes Registering Crypto Exchanges Offering Leverage
top_signals.summary: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission unveiled a proposal Monday to regulate digital asset transactions and markets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Latin American Currencies Lead EM Gains With Real Outpeforming
top_signals.summary: Latin American currencies are posting some of the best performances in emerging markets on Monday, with the Brazilian real spearheading gains after right-wing candidate Flávio Bolsonaro surged to a surprise lead in the first round of the presidential election.

top_signals.title: Surging Brazil Currency Helps Lift Sugar and Coffee Futures
top_signals.summary: A surprise lead for Flávio Bolsonaro in Brazil’s first round of the presidential election sent the nation’s currency soaring, helping lift prices of the biggest soft commodities exports from South America’s agricultural powerhouse.
